subject: [PATCH v3 5/6] btrfs: handle ENOMEM from btrfs_insert_dir_item() without aborting

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Btrfs file system to handle ENOMEM errors from btrfs_insert_dir_item() without aborting the transaction. It adds error handling for -ENOMEM in two functions, btrfs_add_link() and btrfs_create_new_inode(), allowing them to recover from memory pressure instead of crashing the filesystem. The patch also updates the orphan cleanup process to persist nlink 0 when an inode is orphaned due to ENOMEM. This change improves the robustness of Btrfs under memory-constrained conditions, preventing potential data loss and corruption.
